profile.primary_concern: fear of additional side effects due to past health issues

context: As a woman recovering from cancer treatment, she feels uncertain about starting PrEP. Her experience with health challenges has made her cautious and fearful about introducing new medications into her routine. She worries about how PrEP may affect her body and whether it will complicate her recovery journey. Additionally, she is concerned about the stigma associated with taking PrEP and how others might perceive her situation.
